How to run the walking test +
  1. Measure and mark A, B and C on the floor. Use the distances entered above; A → B is straight ahead and B → C is a left turn.
  2. Open this HTTPS page directly in Safari on iPhone or Chrome on Android. Enable sensors and allow permissions. Browser and device support vary.
  3. Stand still at A, hold your phone flat in portrait facing B, and tap Set A & start tracking. Your initial heading becomes the forward axis.
  4. Walk to B, stop and tap I'm at B. Note the error. Resume, turn left with the phone, then walk to C and tap I'm at C.
  5. Repeat without correcting between points to measure accumulated drift. For a separate correction test, choose Use this point as my position after measuring at B.
  6. Export the CSV before starting a new test. Compare detected steps with your own count; adjust step length or threshold between tests.

Position is estimated from detected steps × configured step length and relative phone heading. It uses no GPS and does not snap to the reference points. Phone rotation, shaking, missed steps and orientation drift can cause errors. This is an experimental tracker, not validated indoor positioning.
